title: Tencent Zhang Jun's hands-on test of WorkBuddy project features: Inviting people, sharing, and collaboration - it finally feels like a team working with AI

content_html:
Tencent's Public Relations Director Zhang Jun revealed on a social platform that the "Project" feature of WorkBuddy has been quietly upgraded. After testing it, he commented that after setting up a project and inviting members to join, the team can share all materials, collaborate on tasks, and synchronize project progress. Through the comment function, users can specify who should follow up or share information. The overall experience was described as "extremely smooth."

Zhang Jun also mentioned a specific detail—he created a set of skills (abilities) within the project, allowing all participating students to use them together. This feature makes AI no longer just an individual assistant working alone, but a shared capability integrated into the team collaboration process. He summarized the upgrade experience as: "It really feels like having a group of people working with AI."

From Personal Assistant to Team Hub: A New Paradigm for AI Collaboration

The significance of this feature update lies in the fact that AI tools are evolving from the "one person, one AI assistant" isolated model to a "multiple people sharing one AI collaboration space" team hub model. In traditional office software, document sharing, task assignment, and progress synchronization often take place in different tools. WorkBuddy integrates AI capabilities directly into this collaboration workflow—project members not only see shared materials but can also access the unified AI skills within the project, achieving "person + person + AI" tripartite collaboration.

When every team member can access shared information in real time, AI assists each member in advancing their tasks as needed, and all actions are recorded in the same project space, then "working with AI" is no longer just a slogan, but a quantifiable productivity gain. This may be the crucial step toward AI transitioning from a productivity tool to an organizational collaboration infrastructure.

content_html_zh:
腾讯公关总监张军在社交平台透露，WorkBuddy的“项目”功能已悄然升级。 经过测试，他评价说，建立项目并邀请成员加入后，团队可以共享所有材料、协作完成任务、同步项目进度。 通过评论功能，用户可以指定谁应该跟进或分享信息。 整体体验被描述为“极其顺利”。

张军还提到了一个具体的细节——他在项目中创建了一套技能（能力），让所有参与的学生一起使用。 这一特性使得AI不再只是一个单独工作的个体助手，而是集成到团队协作流程中的共享能力。 他将此次升级体验总结为：“真的感觉就像一群人在和AI一起工作。”

从个人助理到团队中心：人工智能协作的新范式

此次功能更新的意义在于，AI工具正在从“一人一AI助理”的孤立模式，演变成“多人共享一个AI协作空间”的团队中心模式。 在传统办公软件中，文档共享、任务分配、进度同步往往发生在不同的工具中。 WorkBuddy将AI能力直接融入到这个协作流程中，项目成员不仅可以看到共享的素材，还可以访问项目内统一的AI技能，实现“人+人+AI”三方协作。

当每个团队成员都能实时访问共享信息，AI根据需要协助每个成员推进任务，所有动作都记录在同一个项目空间中，那么“与AI一起工作”不再只是一句口号，而是可量化的生产力提升。 这可能是人工智能从生产力工具转变为组织协作基础设施的关键一步。
